joel.docs: quick sync  i've opened a small PR fixing streaming/pagination snippets across py/ts/go. main fixes: context-managed streams in py, AsyncIterator in ts, and safe resume-token handling in go. https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4920
tia-sdk: nice. any user-facing behaviour change?
joel.docs: no breaking API changes. purely docs/snippet surface changes and tests. python example now uses `with client.stream_chat(...) as s:` to ensure socket close.
harry-eng: can you paste the three snippets inline? i'll run the integration examples.
joel.docs: pasted below:
```py
with client.stream_chat(prompt) as s:
  for ev in s:
    if ev.type == 'delta':
      print(ev.delta)
```
```ts
for await (const ev of client.streamResponses(req)) {
  if (ev.kind === 'delta') console.log(ev.delta)
}
```
```go
// ensure resume token isn't reused across requests
tok := resume.Clone()
for {
  resp, err := client.List(ctx, tok)
  if err != nil { return err }
  tok = resp.NextToken.Clone()
}
```
tia-sdk: CI flagged one python file still using the old generator (AttributeError: 'generator' object has no __enter__). might be docs/quickstart/streams.md line ~78.
joel.docs: thanks, fixing that now. also adding a one-line note about retries + streaming: "Prefer connection-level retries; use resume tokens for application-level continuation to avoid duplicating user input."
